entities.name: Gallidi
entities.description: Port city on the Onyx Bridge in Jamuraa, a trade hub between eastern and western Jamuraa that sells grain to Corondor.

entities.name: Onyx Bridge
entities.description: Land bridge in Jamuraa on which Gallidi stands.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of the Robaran Mercenaries who came to Gallidi in 3335 AR.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Mercenary company led by Adira Strongheart.

events.summary: In 3335 AR Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries arrive at Gallidi by Corondorian ship, then cross the Onyx Bridge and return to Bryce.
events.quote: came to Gallidi on a Corondorian sailing vessel
